text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and would love to help build your Google Sheets meal planning document. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, Excel, Google Sheets, and data visualization, and I’m comfortable organizing clean, practical spreadsheets that are easy to use.

I can compile 20 healthy meals with ingredients and recipes that meet your requirements: no red meat, minimally processed ingredients, varied cuisines, and accessible grocery-store items. I’ll structure everything clearly in Google Sheets so it’s simple to review, compare, and update.

One relevant project I built was Shopify customer segments for Juniper & Ash Home using Google Sheets, Looker Studio, and Shopify order exports. The segments helped identify the top group as 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and supported a 19% increase in email revenue.

I’d be glad to help with this project.
